tools.name: recommend_provider
tools.description: Return a provider recommendation for the SEARCH category. Supported modes are ECONOMY and CRITICAL. AOPX only recommends; it does not execute or pay the provider. After executing the returned provider path, call report_outcome with the same recommendation_id so the real production result can feed fu

tools.name: report_outcome
tools.description: Report the real production result of a previous AOPX recommendation. Call this after executing the provider path returned by recommend_provider. The recommendation_id must exist, only one outcome is accepted per recommendation, and the reported provider attempts must match the recommended primary/fa

tools.name: public_stats
tools.description: Return aggregate AOPX production consultation/outcome statistics. LAB benchmarks, tests, shadow runs and replay events are excluded.

tools.name: public_outcomes
tools.description: Return the latest reported production outcomes for AOPX. Provider identities are exposed only through public aliases.
